# Around Films

> > Around Films is a film collective and production company operating ARFF International Film Festival, an annual IMDb-qualifying event for independent filmmakers worldwide.

Around Films serves as both a creative production hub offering post-production services and the organizing body behind ARFF International (Around International Film Festival), which showcases independent cinema and provides networking opportunities for international filmmakers through film screenings, submissions, and IMDb qualification pathways.

- Independent Cinema
